parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
accordingly[əˈkɔːrdɪŋli]adv.
If someone acts accordingly, they act in a way that is suitable.
→ He feels like he did a good job, and his boss should pay him accordingly.
😎
anchor[ˈæŋkər]n.
An anchor is a heavy object dropped from a boat to make it stay in one place.
→ When the ship reached its destination, the crew dropped the anchor.
😎
buoy[ˈbuːi]n.
A buoy is a floating sign that warns boats of dangerous areas.
→ Don’t steer the boat near those buoys. There are rocks underneath the water.
😎
catastrophe[kəˈtæstrəfi]n.
A catastrophe is an unexpected event that causes great suffering or damage.
→ It was a catastrophe for my family when my dad lost his job.
😎
context[ˈkɑːntekst]n.
Context is the situations that form the background of an event.
→ They studied the context of the battle before giving their presentation.
😎
designate[ˈdezɪɡneɪt]v.
To designate someone or something means to give them a particular description.
→ The famous lighthouse was designated a historical monument.
😎
distort[dɪˈstɔːrt]v.
To distort something means to lie about it.
→ His lawyer distorted the facts so that he would be set free.
😎
dock[dɑːk]n.
A dock is an enclosed area where ships go to be loaded, unloaded, and repaired.
→ The huge ship pulled into the dock, and the crew unloaded the cargo.
😎
fore[fɔːr]n.
The fore of something is the front part of it.
→ The teacher’s desk is at the fore of the classroom.
😎
frequent[ˈfriːkwənt]adj.
If something is frequent, then it happens or is done often.
→ While Dad was sick, the doctor made frequent visits to his house.
😎
genuine[ˈdʒenjuɪn]adj.
When something is genuine, it is true or real.
→ After the painting was determined to be genuine, it sold for a million dollars.
😎
grease[ɡriːs]n.
Grease is an oily substance put on moving parts, so they work smoothly.
→ When I was done working on the car, I had grease all over my hands.
😎
intricate[ˈɪntrɪkət]adj.
When something is intricate, it has many small parts or details.
→ The intricate painting on the quilt was very lovely.
😎
offset[ˌɔːfˈset]v.
To offset means to use one thing to cancel out the effect of another thing.
→ Increased wages are offset by higher prices for goods.
😎
overlap[ˌoʊvərˈlæp]v.
To overlap something means to cover a piece of it.
→ The gift on top overlaps the other gift on the bottom.
😎
precipitate[prɪˈsɪpɪteɪt]v.
To precipitate an event means to cause it to happen sooner than normal.
→ The violent attack precipitated an all-out war.
😎
secondhand[ˌsekəndˈhænd]adj.
When something is secondhand, it has been owned by someone else.
→ Her secondhand jeans were a bit faded in the front.
😎
slot[slɑːt]n.
A slot is a narrow opening in a machine or container.
→ To operate the machine, put your coins into the slot.
😎
submerge[səbˈmɜːrdʒ]v.
To submerge something means to put it below the surface of a liquid.
→ The whale submerged its huge body into the ocean.
😎
tactic[ˈtæktɪk]n.
A tactic is a careful plan to achieve something.
→ Sam thought of a good tactic in order to attract more business.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: 1. Which person uses an anchor?
questions.explanation: "anchor" (mỏ neo) là dụng cụ của thủy thủ (sailor) dùng trên thuyền.

questions.content: 2. If your jacket is made of genuine leather, it______ .
questions.explanation: "genuine" (thật, chính hãng) có nghĩa là đồ da thật (real leather).

questions.content: 3. What might precipitate a fight?
questions.explanation: "precipitate" (đẩy nhanh, gây ra) một cuộc đánh nhau thường là do chửi rủa, lăng mạ (name calling).

questions.content: 4. Where would you most likely see a buoy?
questions.explanation: "buoy" (phao cứu sinh, phao cảnh báo) thường được nhìn thấy trên đại dương (on the ocean).

questions.content: 5. If a problem is frequent, then it happens,
questions.explanation: "frequent" (thường xuyên) nghĩa là xảy ra nhiều lần (several times).

sections.title: Exercise 2: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: 1. I buy most of my clothes once owned.
questions.explanation: "once owned" (từng thuộc về người khác) đồng nghĩa với secondhand (đồ cũ).

questions.content: 2. The enclosed area in the harbor for loading ships is very busy this time of day.
questions.explanation: "The enclosed area in the harbor for loading ships" (khu vực bến cảng để chất hàng lên tàu) đồng nghĩa với dock (bến tàu).

questions.content: 3. Be sure not to lie about the facts about the crime. The police need to know everything in order to help us.
questions.explanation: "lie about" (nói dối về) đồng nghĩa với distort (xuyên tạc).

questions.content: 4. The women sat on the front part of the ship and enjoyed the warm sun.
questions.explanation: "the front part" (phần phía trước) đồng nghĩa với fore (phía trước tàu).

questions.content: 5. I have to add a stop to our trip, so adjust your plans in a way that depends on the situation.
questions.explanation: "in a way that depends on the situation" (tùy theo tình huống) đồng nghĩa với accordingly (một cách phù hợp).

questions.content: 6. To understand this show, you have to know the general situation that relates to it.
questions.explanation: "general situation" (tình huống chung, bối cảnh) đồng nghĩa với context (ngữ cảnh, bối cảnh).

questions.content: 7. The new sewing machine was made up of many small parts and details.
questions.explanation: "many small parts and details" (nhiều bộ phận và chi tiết nhỏ) đồng nghĩa với intricate (phức tạp, tinh xảo).

questions.content: 8. Let’s hope that our plans do not have a part of one occupying the space of the other.
questions.explanation: "occupying the space of the other" (chiếm không gian của cái khác) đồng nghĩa với overlap (chồng chéo).

questions.content: 9. The city has decided to give a particular description of this area as a non-smoking zone.
questions.explanation: "give a particular description" (chỉ định) đồng nghĩa với designate.

questions.content: 10. I think the gears need a little more oily substance used to make parts work smoothly.
questions.explanation: "oily substance" (chất nhờn, dầu mỡ) đồng nghĩa với grease.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write Correct if the italicized word is used correctly. Write Incorrect if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: 1. The key fit perfectly in the slot.
questions.explanation: "slot" (khe, rãnh) dùng đúng cho chìa khóa.

questions.content: 2. Jackets help to offset the effect of a cold wind.
questions.explanation: "offset" (bù đắp, làm giảm tác động) dùng đúng khi áo khoác chống lại gió lạnh.

questions.content: 3. I need to distort my homework if I’m going to get it turned in by tomorrow.
questions.explanation: "distort" (xuyên tạc, bóp méo) không dùng cho việc làm bài tập về nhà.

questions.content: 4. The parade was a catastrophe. It went smoothly, and everyone had a great time.
questions.explanation: "catastrophe" (thảm họa) mâu thuẫn với việc buổi diễu hành diễn ra suôn sẻ (went smoothly).

questions.content: 5. They had to water the tree four times a day. It was a frequent chore.
questions.explanation: "frequent" (thường xuyên) dùng đúng cho việc tưới cây 4 lần một ngày.

questions.content: 6. The intricate bench was just a large, unpainted piece of wood.
questions.explanation: "intricate" (tinh xảo, phức tạp) mâu thuẫn với một khúc gỗ thô không sơn (unpainted piece of wood).

questions.content: 7. The weather precipitates a great weekend.
questions.explanation: "precipitates" (gây ra, đẩy nhanh) thường đi với điều tiêu cực hoặc biến cố, không dùng với "great weekend".

questions.content: 8. We walked to the docks to watch ships pull in and out.
questions.explanation: "docks" (bến tàu) dùng đúng với ngữ cảnh xem tàu cập bến.

questions.content: 9. The lion submerged out of the bushes and attacked its prey.
questions.explanation: "submerged" (lặn xuống nước) không dùng cho sư tử phóng ra từ bụi rậm.

questions.content: 10. The secondhand book was brand new. I was the first to read it.
questions.explanation: "secondhand" (đồ cũ) mâu thuẫn với "brand new" (hoàn toàn mới).

questions.content: 11. She was noted for creating some imaginative tactics to claim victory.
questions.explanation: "tactics" (chiến thuật) dùng đúng để giành chiến thắng.

questions.content: 12. The guide asked us to be very quiet, so we acted accordingly.
questions.explanation: "accordingly" (một cách phù hợp) dùng đúng cho việc làm theo lời hướng dẫn viên.

questions.content: 13. The chef arranged the slices of bread so that they overlapped each other.
questions.explanation: "overlapped" (xếp chồng lên nhau) dùng đúng cho lát bánh mì.

questions.content: 14. We knew from the beginning that the genuine man was not who he claimed to be.
questions.explanation: "genuine" (chân thật) mâu thuẫn với việc người đàn ông đó không phải là người anh ta nhận ("not who he claimed to be").

questions.content: 15. The buoy over there warns ships that the water is too shallow.
questions.explanation: "buoy" (phao cảnh báo) dùng đúng để cảnh báo tàu bè.

questions.content: 16. We stood at the fore of the ship. At the front we could see where we were going.
questions.explanation: "fore" (phần mũi tàu) đồng nghĩa với front, dùng đúng.

questions.content: 17. The grease made it easy to find a good parking spot.
questions.explanation: "grease" (dầu mỡ bôi trơn) không liên quan gì đến việc tìm chỗ đậu xe.

questions.content: 18. The fireman who saved the family was designated the “hero of the month.”
questions.explanation: "designated" (được phong, được chỉ định) dùng đúng cho danh hiệu anh hùng.

questions.content: 19. Check the context for spelling errors before you turn it in to the teacher.
questions.explanation: "context" (ngữ cảnh) bị dùng sai, đáng lẽ phải là "content" hoặc "essay".

questions.content: 20. This looks like a good place to drop the boat’s anchor and relax in the sun.
questions.explanation: "anchor" (mỏ neo) dùng đúng khi thả neo thuyền để nghỉ ngơi.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
Jane's Pride

Jane and her father, Mike, owned a secondhand boat. They called it "High Hopes." The two loved to spend time together on the ocean and would often go on long fishing trips.

Mike taught Jane how to perform important tasks. Jane learned how to steer the boat and adjust the sails. She learned how to put grease on the intricate gears of the motor. She learned how to submerge the anchor and secure it by putting a rope in a slot. Jane liked helping her father, but she thought that she wasn't very good at it. Sometimes, she omitted important steps and made frequent mistakes. Jane thought she wasn't capable of manual labor.

Mike wanted to prove to her that she was indeed capable and important. He thought of a tactic to test Jane's skills in the context of a catastrophe. He hid under the deck and pretended to be trapped. He shouted, "Jane, I can't get out! You have to get back to the dock and find help!"

Jane began to panic. She thought she might make her usual mistakes, which would precipitate a disaster. However, she had to listen to her dad and act accordingly. She pulled up the anchor with all of her might. She remembered to overlap the sails to offset the wind. She steered the boat around buoys where the water was shallow. When they got to shore, Mike came out from under the deck.

Jane said, "I thought you were trapped!"

Mike laughed. He said, "It wasn't a genuine emergency. I distorted the truth to test your abilities. Look at what a great job you did getting the boat home safely! I knew you could do it."

To honor his daughter, Mike decided to rename his boat. He designated it "Jane's Pride" and painted the name on the fore of the ship. Jane finally had something to be proud of.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement True or False.

questions.content: 1. Jane thought she would precipitate a disaster if she omitted her frequent mistakes.
questions.explanation: Jane nghĩ mình sẽ gây ra thảm họa nếu cô ấy mắc lỗi thường xuyên (made her frequent mistakes), không phải bỏ qua chúng.

questions.content: 2. Jane submerged the anchor and secured it by putting a rope in a slot.
questions.explanation: Jane đã học được cách thả neo (submerge the anchor) và cố định bằng sợi dây qua rãnh (slot).

questions.content: 3. Jane put grease on the intricate buoy.
questions.explanation: Cô ấy bôi trơn (grease) lên các bánh răng phức tạp (intricate gears) của động cơ, không phải lên chiếc phao (buoy).

questions.content: 4. Mike thought of a tactic to test Jane’s skills in the context of a catastrophe.
questions.explanation: Mike đã nghĩ ra một chiến thuật (tactic) để kiểm tra kỹ năng của con gái trong tình huống thảm họa.

questions.content: 5. Mike designated the secondhand boat “Jane’s Pride.”
questions.explanation: Ông ấy đã đặt tên (designated) con thuyền cũ là "Jane's Pride".

questions.content: 1. Where did Jane have to steer the boat to find help?
questions.explanation: Bố Jane bảo cô phải đưa tàu về bến (dock) để tìm sự giúp đỡ.

questions.content: 2. What was the first thing Jane did after she decided to listen to her dad and act accordingly?
options: She pulled up the anchor with all of her might.
She put grease on the intricate gears.
questions.explanation: Việc đầu tiên Jane làm là dốc sức kéo mỏ neo lên (pulled up the anchor).

questions.content: 3. On which part of the boat did they paint the name?
options: On the fore of the ship
questions.explanation: Cái tên mới được vẽ ở phần mũi tàu (fore of the ship).

questions.content: 4. When Jane overlapped the sails, what was she trying to offset?
questions.explanation: Cô xếp chồng các cánh buồm (overlap the sails) để cản lại sức gió (offset the wind).

questions.content: 5. What was the purpose of Mike deceiving his daughter?
options: To prove to her that she was capable and important
To make her precipitate a disaster
questions.explanation: Mục đích của Mike là chứng minh rằng con gái mình rất có năng lực và quan trọng (capable and important).
